audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows gave the lane to Lucian or called it a coinflip while the prose beside them describes an Irelia takeover. whys[1] ends with 'it's a wash' on a row marked Lucian; whys[2] says your stun finally beats his kite on a row marked Lucian; whys[3], whys[4] and whys[5] describe out-DPSing him, a premier dive window and forcing every all-in, all on rows marked Lucian or Skill. The difficulty rating of 8.5/10 also sat on top of a 53.02% win rate over 1769 games.
audit.why: The page reads as a losing matchup in its metadata and a winning one in its text. The packet chart agrees with the text at every row from 1 to 5.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped in both layers as one atomic group with matching ratings, and diffRating moved from 8.5/10 to 6.5/10 with the two prose strings that quote the number. Level 1 stays Lucian. 2+ items left as Lucian — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page is built on 'track Relentless Pursuit' without ever saying that its cooldown is not fixed — Lightslinger attacks reduce it. It is also never given a number.
audit.why: Telling a player to count to 16 seconds is actively wrong here: a Lucian who lands his double-shots gets the dash back early, so the read is his attack count, not a stopwatch. This is the single most decisive timing fact in the matchup and it was absent.
audit.corrected: The 16s rank-1 cooldown and its Lightslinger reduction written into whys[3] and wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Lightslinger's second clause — Lucian's next two attacks deal bonus magic damage when a nearby enemy champion is immobilized — is nowhere on the page. whys[0] and spikes[0] also claim Piercing Light out-ranges Bladesurge; Q is 500 range and Bladesurge is 600, so the range claim is backwards even though the conclusion (don't step up without a dash target) is right.
audit.why: The immobilize clause is what turns a jungle gank from a 2v1 into a burst window: any CC landed on you empowers his next two shots. A player who does not know that will hold position through the gank expecting the same damage he was doing in lane.
audit.corrected: Immobilize clause written into mid as the reason not to eat jungle CC near him; the reversed range claim replaced with the accurate reason (no minion to dash to) in whys[0].

audit.why: The packet flagged 'Relentless Pursuit' in wants.foe[1] as a probable wrong name. It is a false positive — that is the exact Riot name for Lucian's E.

Defiant Dance reduces physical damage and Lucian's damage is physical, so the existing 'hold W for his double-shot trade' advice is genuinely correct here and was left alone. Plated Steelcaps in report[8] is likewise right for once.

edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Relentless Pursuit and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.after: Your passive stacks toward max on-hit and your resets tighten, so you out-DPS him once you stick — but his autos shorten Relentless Pursuit.

edits.after: Bait Relentless Pursuit (E), then commit fast — 16s at rank 1, but every Lightslinger shot he lands cuts that timer down

edits.before: This is your window. With E up and your passive stacking toward max, every all-in starts the same — land Flawless Duet, then Bladesurge onto the E-marked Lucian so the dash resets and your stacking on-hit shreds his armor before he can answer. His only out is Relentless Pursuit (E), so track it; if that dash is down, you run him over. At 6, drop Vanguard's Edge behind him so the blade wall physically blocks his escape dash and traps him in your reset chain with nowhere to kite.
edits.after: This is your window. With E up and your passive stacking toward max, every all-in starts the same — land Flawless Duet, then Bladesurge onto the E-marked Lucian so the dash resets and your on-hit shreds him. His only out is Relentless Pursuit, and his own attacks shorten it, so count shots not seconds. Never eat jungle CC beside him either: any immobilised champion nearby empowers his next two shots. At 6, drop Vanguard's Edge behind him so the wall cuts off the escape dash.

notes: Difficulty was rated 8.5/10 on a 53.02% matchup across 1769 games, with five chart rows marked for Lucian while the prose beside them described an Irelia takeover; the rows and the rating are corrected together. The 2+ items row is left as Lucian: the packet chart says Skill there, but this page's whys[6] argues he eclipses you, and I had no basis in the kits to overrule the prose — flagged rather than guessed. Biggest mechanical gap closed: Relentless Pursuit's cooldown is reduced by Lightslinger attacks, so 'wait out his dash' by clock is the wrong read. Lightslinger's immobilise clause was also entirely absent.
